mapper.select: SELECT F.FAULT_SEQ AS "faultSeq" , F.GLOBAL_ID AS "globalId" , F.CALL_DATE AS "requestDate" , F.CALL_TIME AS "requestTime" , F.JNL_DATE AS "jnlDate" , F.JNL_TIME AS "jnlTime" , LPAD(TO_CHAR(NVL(F.MANAGE_NO, 1)), 2, '0') AS "manageNo" , CASE WHEN F.PROVIDER_TYPE_CD IN ('1', '4') THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS "dispatchOrderType" , F.TERM_GROUP_ID AS "termGroupId" , B.TERM_GROUP_NAME AS "termGroupName" , A.CORNER_CD AS "cornerCd" , SUBSTR(C.CORNER_NAME, 1, 40) AS "cornerName" , F.TERM_ID AS "termId" , A.ATM_CO_CD AS "atmCoCd" , A.MODEL_CD AS "modelCd" , F.REQUEST_TYPE_CD AS "requestTypeCd" , F.REQUEST_REASON_CD AS "requestReasonCd" , TRIM(F.SERVICE_PERSON) AS "servicePerson" , TRIM(F.SERVICE_PHONE_NO) AS "servicePhoneNo" , F.ERR_GROUP_CD AS "errGroupCd" , F.ERR_CD AS "errCd" , F.FAULT_CLASS_CD AS "faultClassCd" , TRIM(F.FAULT_DESC) AS "requestComment" , F.CUSTOMER_WAIT_FLAG AS "customerWaitFlag" , F.PROVIDER_TYPE_CD AS "providerTypeCd" , F.VENDOR_CD AS "providerCd" FROM T_FAULT_MANAGEMENT F LEFT JOIN T_ATM A ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = F.TERM_GROUP_ID AND A.TERM_ID = F.TERM_ID LEFT JOIN T_ATM_GROUP B ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = B.TERM_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN T_CORNER C ON A.CORNER_CD = C.CORNER_CD AND A.TERM_GROUP_ID = C.TERM_GROUP_ID WHERE F.FAULT_SEQ = #{faultSeq}

SELECT C.TERM_GROUP_ID AS "termGroupId" , SUBSTR(B.TERM_GROUP_NAME, 1, 40) AS "termGroupName" , C.CORNER_CD AS "cornerCd" , SUBSTR(C.CORNER_NAME, 1, 40) AS "cornerName" , C.CORNER_TYPE_CD AS "cornerTypeCd" , C.OPERATION_TYPE_CD AS "operationTypeCd" , C.OUTSRC_CO_CD AS "outsrcCoCd" , SUBSTR(C.ADDRESS, 1, 40) AS "address" , C.BRANCH_CD AS "branchCd" FROM T_CORNER C LEFT JOIN T_ATM_GROUP B ON B.TERM_GROUP_ID = C.TERM_GROUP_ID WHERE C.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND C.CORNER_CD = #{cornerCd}

SELECT D.ADD_INFO AS "addInfo" , S.PROVIDER_NAME AS "providerName" , A.ATM_CO_CD AS "atmCoCd" FROM T_SERVICE_PROVIDER S LEFT JOIN T_CORNER C ON S.PROVIDER_CD = C.PARTNER_CD LEFT JOIN T_ATM A ON C.TERM_GROUP_ID = A.TERM_GROUP_ID AND C.CORNER_CD = A.CORNER_CD LEFT JOIN T_ATM_DEVICE_STATUS D ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = D.TERM_GROUP_ID AND A.TERM_ID = D.TERM_ID WHERE A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT A.CORNER_CD AS "cornerCd" , SUBSTR(C.CORNER_NAME, 1, 40) AS "cornerName" , A.MODEL_CD AS "modelCd" , A.ATM_CO_CD AS "atmCoCd" , C.BRANCH_CD AS "branchCd" FROM T_ATM A LEFT JOIN T_CORNER C ON A.CORNER_CD = C.CORNER_CD AND A.TERM_GROUP_ID = C.TERM_GROUP_ID WHERE A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_ATM_MONITOR ( TERM_GROUP_ID , TERM_ID , JNL_DATE , JNL_TIME , AGENT_TYPE , ATM_STATUS , SEND_FLAG , RECV_DATE , RECV_TIME ) VALUES ( #{termGroupId} , #{termId} , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'HH24MISSFF6'), 1, 10) , '9' , #{atmStatus} , '0' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'HH24MISSFF6'), 1, 10) )
mapper.update:
UPDATE T_ATM_STATUS
LAST_ATM_CALL_DATE = NULL , LAST_ATM_CALL_TIME = NULL , LAST_ATM_SNO = NULL , LAST_ATM_FAULT_CLASS_CD = NULL
LAST_OUT_CALL_DATE = NULL , LAST_OUT_CALL_TIME = NULL , LAST_OUT_SNO = NULL , FAULT_CLASS_CD = NULL
LAST_KEY_CALL_DATE = NULL , LAST_KEY_CALL_TIME = NULL , LAST_KEY_SNO = NULL , LAST_KEY_FAULT_CLASS_CD = NULL
LAST_OUT_CALL_DATE = NULL , LAST_OUT_CALL_TIME = NULL , LAST_OUT_SNO = NULL , FAULT_CLASS_CD = NULL
WHERE TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND TERM_ID = #{termId}
